title: The query-log redactor catches a long token after an equals sign and the common cloud key shapes
goal: redact.redact replaces a token of 20 or more characters holding a letter and a digit after key= (today the TOKEN lookbehind at redact.py:81 refuses an = before it, so token=<32 chars> survives while token: is caught), keeping the words filter so identifiers stay; kbcommon.SECRETS gains the Google API key (AIza), Stripe live key (sk_live_), npm token (npm_) and SendGrid (SG.) shapes, and the Entra client-secret shape only after it is confirmed against Microsoft Learn (a kb fact or source row). Measured on ST-yl6b2ues's corpus: the key x separator x value matrix leaks at most 12 of 360 (93 today), utility rows unchanged, the rewrite rate on engineering text at most 0.8% (0.7% today). Key-name and command-flag forms (cmdkey, net use, sqlcmd -P, XML Password) are out of scope. Stored entries that fail check after the widening are re-redacted with querylog.py reredact as querylog.md says. Evidence: reliability-authority-review.md RD-2.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import redact as r;v='Zx9Qm4'+'Lp7Rt2Vb8Nc5Kd3Wf6Hj';s='token='+v;g='AI'+'zaSyD'+'Qm4Lp7Rt2Vb8Nc5Kd3Wf6Hj01234567';ok=v not in r.redact(s) and g not in r.redact('key '+g);print(ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbcommon as k;t='Qm4Lp7Rt2Vb8Nc5Kd3Wf6Hj01';vals=['AI'+'za'+'SyD'+t+'2345678','sk_'+'live_'+t,'npm_'+t+'Ab9x8Yz7Wq','SG'+'.'+t[:22]+'.'+t+'Ab9x8Yz7Wq6Vu5Ts4Rp'];miss=[v[:6] for v in vals if not k.leak_hits('key '+v)];print(miss);sys.exit(0 if not miss else 1)

gates.question: How does kbcommon.SECRETS gain the Google API key, Stripe live key, npm token and SendGrid shapes?
options: One entry with the AWS key id as alternatives
Four new entries, with test_leaks.secret_plants extended
gates.recommendation: One entry with the AWS key id as alternatives
gates.reason: test_leaks.secret_plants and its count test pair one plant per entry and that file is outside the touches
gates.answer: One entry with the AWS key id as alternatives

gates.question: Is the Entra client-secret shape added as a fixed-prefix pattern?
options: Added as a pattern with the Q~ marker
gates.reason: Microsoft Learn's Purview page (purview/sit-defn-azure-ad-client-secret) gives only a charset of letters, digits, dash, underline, dot and tilde and up to 40 characters, with no fixed marker, and the kb holds no fact or source row for one; the TOKEN rule after key= already covers such a value

gates.question: On which matrix is the leak count measured, since the corpus matrix holds no long value and the lead's 93 of 360 cannot be reproduced on it?
options: Add a test-side matrix of the corpus's long value over its keys, separators and quoting depths
Add the long value to the corpus matrix
gates.recommendation: Add a test-side matrix of the corpus's long value over its keys, separators and quoting depths
gates.reason: it leaks 1 of 128 before and 0 of 128 after, while a long value in the corpus matrix would add about 100 rows the scan misses and break its known-gap maximum
gates.answer: Add a test-side matrix of the corpus's long value over its keys, separators and quoting depths

gates.question: Where may a long token start after an equals sign, and how long are the cloud shapes?
options: After any single equals sign, shapes with the real prefixes and minimum lengths
Only after a name ending in a credential word
gates.recommendation: After any single equals sign, shapes with the real prefixes and minimum lengths
gates.reason: the words filter keeps identifiers, the rewrite rate on engineering text measured 0.66% before and after, and npm needs only 30 characters so the planted value passes
gates.answer: After any single equals sign, shapes with the real prefixes and minimum lengths
